name: star-manager
description: Electron + Vue + Python desktop app for Star_Manager.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=&& set ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173&& electron ."
scripts.test:card-plugin: set DOTNET_CLI_HOME=%CD%\.dotnet-home&& set DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE=1&& set DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1&& dotnet run --project tools/star-manager-card-metadata-plugin/validation/StarManager.CardMetadata.Validation.csproj --configuration Release
scripts.build:card-plugin: npm run test:card-plugin && set DOTNET_CLI_HOME=%CD%\.dotnet-home&& set DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE=1&& set DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1&& dotnet build tools/star-manager-card-metadata-plugin/StarManager.CardMetadata.csproj --configuration Release
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run build:backend && electron-builder --win dir --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.electron: npm run build && set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=&& electron .
